observedTeamState.meaning: External/team-capacity suspension is containing execution, but logical activation remains. Pause is not a structural fix.

requiredCallerTopology: AI result -> deterministic materiality classification -> branch; NON_MATERIAL returns exact primary result without BG168; MATERIAL may invoke BG168 once and always preserves exact primary result if learning fails.

requiredBeforeNormalService: Inventory all PH-agent BG168 callers and classify each as guarded or explicitly exempt with evidence.
Migrate the canonical agent template so materiality is decided before paid BG168 invocation.
Verify NON_MATERIAL produces the exact primary result with zero BG168 calls.
Verify MATERIAL produces at most one BG168 call and still returns the exact primary result.
Verify BG168 failure or unavailability never suppresses the primary agent result.
Verify bounded credits per logical outcome under controlled runtime proof.
Verify no uncontrolled burst or 429 occurs during staged resume.
resumeGate.rollout: One inactive staging/canary template first, then small-batch agent rollout with exact blueprint readback and runtime evidence; no big-bang reactivation.

security.rule: Capability-, token-, credential- and secret-like values observed in connected runtime configuration must never be copied into repository artifacts, learning records, logs or user-visible evidence.
security.rotation: Rotation or secret-store migration requires an explicit secure mechanism and authorization; it is not performed autonomously as part of learning retention.
